desc: You're here! The area to be surveyed this time is full of tough enemies, but I'm sure you can take care of them! Do your best to get your hands on some of those great Summoners' Hall rewards!

raw.th: ท่านมาถึงแล้ว! ดินแดนที่จะต้องทำการสำรวจในครั้งนี้มันเต้มไปด้วยศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่ง แต่ข้ามั่นใจว่าท่านต้องจัดการพวกมันได้แน่! ทำให้ดีที่สุดเพื่อจะได้มีโอกาสรับรางวัลอย่างดีจากสภาซัมมอนเนอร์!
raw.vi: Ngươi đây rồi! Khu vực cần điều tra khảo sát lần này có rất nhiều kẻ thù mạnh, nhưng ta tin chắc ngươi có thể xử lý chúng! Hãy làm hết sức mình để có cơ may giành lấy phần thưởng từ Đại sảnh người triệu hồi đấy!

id: Wow, kamu yang terbaik! Pertahankan dan pangkatmu bisa langsung naik 5! Tapi Pemanggil lain juga berusaha yang terbaik, jadi jangan ceroboh!
name: MST_FRONTIERHUNTER_UNIQUEREWARD_2000_COMMENT
desc: Wow, you're the best! Keep this up and your rank could instantly increase by 5! But other Summoners are trying their best as well, so don't get careless!

raw.en: Wow, you're the best! Keep this up and your rank could instantly increase by 5! But other Summoners are trying their best as well, so don't get careless!
raw.es: ¡Vaya, eres el mejor! ¡Sigue así y tu rango podría incrementarse en 5! Pero otros invocadores también hacen su mejor esfuerzo, ¡así que no bajes la guardia!
raw.id: Wow, kamu yang terbaik! Pertahankan dan pangkatmu bisa langsung naik 5! Tapi Pemanggil lain juga berusaha yang terbaik, jadi jangan ceroboh!
raw.pt: Nossa, você é demais! Continue assim e seu nível pode aumentar em 5 na hora! Mas outros invocadores também estão fazendo o máximo que podem, então não relaxe!
raw.th: ว้าว ท่านนี่สุดยอดไปเลย! ทำแบบนี้ไปเรื่อยและอันดับของท่านอาจจะเพิ่มขึ้นอีก 5 ! แต่ซัมมอนเนอร์คนอื่นๆก็กำลังทำอย่างดีที่สุดเช่นกัน ฉะนั้นอย่าได้นิ่งนอนใจ!
raw.vi: Chà, ngươi là tay cừ nhất! Hãy phát huy điểm số và nâng vị trí xếp hạng của bạn lên thêm 5 nhé! Nhưng những Người triệu hồi khác cũng đang cố gắng hết sức có thể, nên đừng để bị sơ sẩy nhé!

id: Hebat! Di posisi ini, pangkatmu bisa naik 4! Ah, tapi sepertinya ada beberapa Pemanggil lain yang mengikuti jejakmu! Bertahanlah sedikit lagi!
name: MST_FRONTIERHUNTER_UNIQUEREWARD_2001_COMMENT
desc: Amazing! At this rate, your rank could increase by 4! Ah, but it looks like there are some other Summoners on your heels! Hold on just a little bit longer!

raw.en: Amazing! At this rate, your rank could increase by 4! Ah, but it looks like there are some other Summoners on your heels! Hold on just a little bit longer!
raw.es: ¡increíble! En este puesto, ¡tu rango podría incrementarse en 4! ¡Ah, pero parece que hay otros invocadores pisándote los talones! ¡Resiste solo un poco más!
raw.id: Hebat! Di posisi ini, pangkatmu bisa naik 4! Ah, tapi sepertinya ada beberapa Pemanggil lain yang mengikuti jejakmu! Bertahanlah sedikit lagi!
raw.pt: Demais! Nesta posição, sua classificação pode aumentar em 4! Ah, mas parece que há outros invocadores atrás! Aguente só mais um pouco!
raw.th: เยี่ยมมาก! ที่ตำแหน่งนี้ อันดับของท่านอาจเพิ่มขึ้นอีก 4! อ๊ะ แต่ดูเหมือนว่ามีซัมมอนเนอร์คนอื่นๆ กำลังไล่ตามมาติดๆ! อดทนเอาไว้อีกหน่อยนะ!
raw.vi: Thật ngạc nhiên! Với tình hình này ngươi hoàn toàn có thể thay đổi vị trí xếp hạng của mình lên thêm 4! À, nhưng nhìn này nó giống như là có một vài Người triệu hồi khác khiến ngươi bị thương! Chỉ giữ tình trạng này một chút nữa thôi nhé!

id: Aku tahu kamu tuh berbakat! Pertahankan dan Pangkat Pemburumu bakal naik 3! Pastinya kamu menarget lebih tinggi dari ini, kan? Aku menyemangatimu!
name: MST_FRONTIERHUNTER_UNIQUEREWARD_2002_COMMENT
desc: I knew you had it in you! Keep this up and your Hunter Rank will increase by 3! But surely you're aiming higher than this, right? I'm cheering for you!

raw.en: I knew you had it in you! Keep this up and your Hunter Rank will increase by 3! But surely you're aiming higher than this, right? I'm cheering for you!
raw.es: ¡Sabía que podías hacerlo! ¡Sigue así y tu rango de cazador se incrementará en 3! Pero seguramente tu objetivo es más alto, ¿vedad? ¡Estoy contigo!

raw.pt: Eu sabia que você conseguiria! Continue assim e sua Classificação de Caçador aumentará em 3! Mas com certeza você quer mais do que isso, não é? Estou torcendo por você!
raw.th: ข้ารู้ว่าท่านต้องทำได้! ทำให้ได้แบบนี้ต่อไปและอันดับนักล่าของท่านจะเพิ่มขึ้นอีก 3! แต่แน่นอนว่าเป้าหมายของท่านอยู่สูงกว่านี้ใช่ไหมล่ะ? ข้าจะคอยเชียร์ท่านนะ!
raw.vi: Ta biết ngươi đã có sẵn điều đó! Hãy phát huy điều này và vị trí Xếp hạng Thợ săn của ngươi sẽ tăng lên thêm 3! Nhưng chắc chắn ngươi đang nhắm cao hơn mức này, phải không? Ta sẽ cổ vũ cho ngươi!

id: Hei! Kerjamu bagus! Kalau kamu mempertahankan ini, Pangkat Pemburumu akan naik 2! Tapi berhati-hatilah karena kalau kamu mundur, pangkatmu akan turun 1. Kamu tidak akan membiarkan hal itu terjadi, kan?
name: MST_FRONTIERHUNTER_UNIQUEREWARD_2003_COMMENT
desc: Hey there! You're doing great! If you keep this up your Hunter Rank will increase by 2! But be careful because if you fall back it will drop back down to 1. You won't let that happen though, right?

raw.en: Hey there! You're doing great! If you keep this up your Hunter Rank will increase by 2! But be careful because if you fall back it will drop back down to 1. You won't let that happen though, right?
raw.es: ¡Hola! ¡Lo estás haciendo muy bien! ¡Si sigues así tu rango de cazador se incrementará en 2! Ten cuidado porque si retrocedes regresará a 1. No dejarás que vuelva a suceder, ¿verdad?
raw.id: Hei! Kerjamu bagus! Kalau kamu mempertahankan ini, Pangkat Pemburumu akan naik 2! Tapi berhati-hatilah karena kalau kamu mundur, pangkatmu akan turun 1. Kamu tidak akan membiarkan hal itu terjadi, kan?
raw.pt: Oi! Você está indo muito bem! Se continuar assim, sua Classificação de Caçador aumentará em 2! Mas cuidado, se você cair ela voltará a 1. Mas você não vai deixar que isso aconteça, né?
raw.th: ว่าไง! ท่านทำได้แจ๋วมาก! ถ้าท่านทำได้แบบนี้ต่อไป อันดับนักล่าของท่านจะเพิ่มขึ้นอีก 2! แต่ระวังด้วยเพราะถ้าท่านพลาดอันดับของท่านจะหล่นลงไปอยู่ที่ 1 แต่ท่านจะไม่ยอมให้มันเป็นแบบนั้นอยู่แล้วใช่ไหมล่ะ?
raw.vi: Ê này! Ngươi làm tuyêt lắm! Nếu người phát huy điều này thì vị trí Xếp hạng thợ săn của ngươi sẽ tăng lên thêm 2! Nhưng phải thật cẩn thận nhé vì nếu làm không tốt ngươi sẽ quay trở lại vạch số 1 đấy. Ngươi hoàn toàn không muốn điều đó xảy ra phải không nào?
